explication: Beacon is a local-first memory and observability layer for AI coding agents. Agent hooks, plugins, OTLP inputs, and cloud-session polling capture cross-harness activity; the observation pipeline normalizes, privacy-sanitizes, evaluates, and persists events as durable JSONL. CLI and dashboard workflows inspect traces, sessions, findings, inventory, and token usage. Approved knowledge is exposed through MCP for reuse by later agents, while optional enrollment and forwarding connect local telemetry to managed destinations. Some subsystem links are inferred from documented capabilities because their implementation was not sampled.
